label: Every POTENCY_1 is of the contradictory: whatever is in POTENCY_1 in a respect can fail to be so in…
paraphrase: Every potency is of the contradictory: whatever is in potency in a respect can fail to be so in that respect, and is in that respect corruptible (simply, when the respect is substance; in a respect, when it is a place, quantity or quality). It does not say that what is in potency in an accidental respect can fail to be in substance.
